## Ctx.editMediaGroup() method

Replaces the current message with a media group filtered by the given type.

**Signature:**

```typescript
editMediaGroup(type?: ITMediaGroupType, data?: ITData, baseId?: string, options?: ITOptReplyPhoto | ITOptReplyVideo | ITOptReplyAudio | ITOptReplyDocument): Promise<(grammy_types.Message.PhotoMessage | grammy_types.Message.VideoMessage | grammy_types.Message.AudioMessage | grammy_types.Message.DocumentMessage | grammy_types.Message.LivePhotoMessage)[]>;
```

The sent media group messages.

## Remarks

Deletes the original message and sends a new media group via `replyMediaGroup`<!-- -->. When `type` is omitted or `undefined`<!-- -->, all items in the `<media-group>` are sent. For a hardcoded type, use the convenience methods (`editPhotoGroup`<!-- -->, `editVideoGroup`<!-- -->, etc.).

## Example


```typescript
async handleCallbackData() {
  // send only photos
  await this.editMediaGroup("photo")
}

async handleShowAll() {
  // send all media-group items
  await this.editMediaGroup()
}
```
